purpose: Implement the artist-controlled connectivity law as a pure transport-eligibility and offline/reconnect transition-planning layer: OFFLINE blocks Internet while preserving localhost/local work, LAN requires explicit approval, pending changes are surfaced before disconnect, and reconnect never auto-syncs or grants authority.

lineage.outcome: The artist can choose OFFLINE without losing local work, see pending remote changes before disconnecting, and reconnect without N0TE silently syncing, uploading, publishing, spending or treating connectivity as action authority.
lineage.capability: Artist-controlled connectivity policy and explicit offline/reconnect transition planning

legacy_candidates: NetworkPolicy/AI-OFF semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: OFFLINE denies INTERNET and permits LOCALHOST by connectivity policy
CONNECTED permits INTERNET transport class but action_authority_granted remains false
LAN is denied without an explicit approval reference and allowed with one in either mode without granting action authority
pending/unsent/unreconciled external changes produce CHOICE_REQUIRED before CONNECTED to OFFLINE
FINISH_FIRST remains CONNECTED and marks external work still required; preserve/proceed choices enter OFFLINE while retaining every pending change ID
no pending changes produce READY offline transition without a fake choice
offline-accumulated changes produce CHOICE_REQUIRED before OFFLINE to CONNECTED with SYNC_NOW/SYNC_SELECTIVELY/POSTPONE/REMAIN_UNSYNCED choices
selected reconciliation choice is returned only as a directive; no sync is performed and action authority remains false
reconnect with no offline changes reports NOTHING_TO_RECONCILE
duplicate change IDs and mode/direction mismatches are rejected
NetworkPolicy exposes no connect/disconnect/send/upload/sync/publish/execute/provider verb and performs no external action
decisions and transition resolution are pure/deterministic and do not mutate the policy instance
next_selection_rule: After CORE-04C evidence, reconcile and globally compare transactional execution/recovery, universal provider execute-once receipts/reconciliation and credentials/trust contracts against preserved CORE-02 Success Memory. Do not add network transport merely because policy now permits a route.
